title: Recording in Atlanta in 1966
summary: He went to Atlanta to record Higgy Comes Home with Bud Freeman and returned for a steady job and the festival.

blocks.x: Yeah, I have that one. I want to find out what playing you've been doing since you came out of the hospital that time when you had the heart condition. I know you went to Atlanta in 1966 to do that record, 'Higgy Comes Home', with Bud Freeman and all of your friends down there. I know after that. But in 1966 you went to Atlanta to do that record. Your friend had sent for you, Lowenstein.
Bud Freeman and I went down to record and then I went back and played on a steady job.
I think it was two weeks. Then I played the Jazz Festival.
